words.definition: v. 打碎；粉碎 n. 轰动之作；猛击

examples.en: The scandal smashed the government's hopes of re-election.
examples.zh: 丑闻粉碎了政府连任的希望。

examples.en: Her debut novel was an instant smash across the country.
examples.zh: 她的处女作在全国一炮而红。

words.usage: 及物动词，宾语多为 window、record、hope 等具体或抽象名词；smash a record 指打破纪录。名词 smash hit 指轰动一时的作品。派生：smashing adj. 极好的。

confusables.note: crash 撞击坠毁；不强调碎
splash 液体飞溅；形近易混

synonyms.note: 打得更碎更彻底；较书面

collocations: smash a record 打破纪录
smash hit 轰动一时的作品
smash the myth 粉碎神话
words.mnemonic: sm+ash(灰) → 砸成灰 → 打碎；粉碎

words.definition: n. 肘；弯头 vt. 用肘挤开

examples.en: He elbowed his way through the crowded platform to catch the train.
examples.zh: 他在拥挤的站台上用肘开路去赶火车。

examples.en: She leaned on her elbows and stared out of the window.
examples.zh: 她双肘支着，凝望窗外。

words.usage: 名词常与 on、at 搭配，如 at one's elbow（在手边）。动词短语 elbow one's way through/into 指用肘挤过人群。派生：elbowroom n. 活动余地。

confusables.note: brow 眉毛额头；br- 开头

collocations: elbow one's way 用肘挤着前进
at one's elbow 在手边；近旁
rub elbows with 与名人交往
words.mnemonic: el+l+bow(弓) → 臂弯如弓 → 肘

words.definition: vi. 暴跌；骤降 n. 低谷；衰退期

examples.en: Car sales slumped by twenty percent during the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 金融危机期间汽车销量骤降两成。

examples.en: The region is struggling to recover from its worst economic slump in decades.
examples.zh: 该地区正艰难摆脱数十年来最严重的经济衰退。

words.usage: 不及物动词，常与 by、to 连用表示降幅；名词多用于 economic slump、sales slump（经济/销售低迷）。表示人「瘫坐」用 slump into a chair。
collocations: economic slump 经济衰退
slump in sales 销量暴跌
hit a slump 陷入低谷
words.mnemonic: 滑入 lump(团)般的低谷 → 暴跌；瘫倒

words.definition: n. 贫民窟；棚户区

examples.en: Millions of city dwellers still live in overcrowded slums.
examples.zh: 数百万城市居民仍住在拥挤不堪的贫民窟里。

examples.en: The city launched a program to clear the slums and build affordable housing.
examples.zh: 该市启动了清除贫民窟、兴建经济适用房的项目。

words.usage: 可数名词，常与 in 连用：live in a slum。动词短语 slum it 指刻意过简陋生活，阅读中偶见。派生：slumlord n. 贫民窟房东。

synonyms.note: 棚户区；多见于拉美语境
贫民区；常指少数族裔聚居

collocations: slum clearance 贫民窟清理改造
live in a slum 住在贫民窟
slum housing 贫民窟住房
words.mnemonic: 音似「死烂」——房死烂的聚居地 → 贫民窟

words.definition: n. 缺乏；不足；缺陷

examples.en: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to serious health problems.
examples.zh: 缺乏维生素D可能导致严重的健康问题。

examples.en: The report pointed out several deficiencies in the education system.
examples.zh: 报告指出了教育体制中的若干缺陷。

words.usage: 常用搭配 a deficiency of 或 in sth（缺乏…）。复数 deficiencies 指体制、报告中的漏洞。近义 lack、shortage。派生：deficient adj. 缺乏的、不足的。
collocations: vitamin deficiency 维生素缺乏
deficiency in nutrition 营养不足
make up a deficiency 弥补不足
words.mnemonic: de(否)+fic(做)+iency → 做得不够 → 缺乏

words.definition: n. 羽毛；翎毛

examples.en: The peacock spread its tail feathers to attract attention.
examples.zh: 孔雀展开尾羽以吸引注意。

examples.en: Winning the scholarship was a feather in her cap.
examples.zh: 获得奖学金是她值得骄傲的成就。

words.usage: 可数名词；习语 a feather in one's cap 指值得骄傲的成就；birds of a feather 指志趣相投的人；light as a feather 形容轻如鸿毛。
collocations: a feather in one's cap 值得骄傲之事
birds of a feather 物以类聚
light as a feather 轻如鸿毛
words.mnemonic: f+eather 联想 weather → 鸟羽抗天气 → 羽毛

words.definition: n. 松紧带 adj. 有弹性的；灵活的

examples.en: The demand for luxury goods tends to be highly elastic.
examples.zh: 奢侈品的需求往往弹性很大。

examples.en: The rules remain elastic, allowing judges some freedom.
examples.zh: 这些规则富有弹性，给法官留有余地。

words.usage: 形容词既指物理弹性，也指规则、安排「灵活可变」，如 elastic rules。经济学中 elastic demand（弹性需求）为高频术语。派生：elasticity n. 弹性。
collocations: elastic demand 弹性需求
elastic band 橡皮筋
elastic rules 灵活的规则
words.mnemonic: e+last(持续)+ic → 拉长能复原 → 有弹性的

words.definition: n. 王国；领域；范围

examples.en: Artificial intelligence has moved from fiction into the realm of daily life.
examples.zh: 人工智能已从幻想走进日常生活领域。

examples.en: Such metaphysical questions lie beyond the realm of science.
examples.zh: 这类形而上学问题超出了科学范畴。

words.usage: 常与介词 in、beyond 连用：in the realm of（在…领域）；beyond the realm of possibility（超出可能范围）。文学中指「王国」，与 kingdom 同义。
collocations: in the realm of 在…领域
beyond the realm of 超出…范围
the political realm 政治领域
words.mnemonic: real(真实)+m → 真实疆域 → 王国；领域

words.definition: n. 赤字；亏损；不足额

examples.en: The government is under pressure to reduce the budget deficit.
examples.zh: 政府面临削减预算赤字的压力。

examples.en: Many rural schools suffer from a deficit of qualified teachers.
examples.zh: 许多乡村学校面临合格师资不足的问题。

words.usage: 经济语境高频：budget deficit（预算赤字）、trade deficit（贸易逆差）。表能力不足用 a deficit in sth；反义词 surplus（盈余）。
collocations: budget deficit 预算赤字
trade deficit 贸易逆差
deficit in skills 技能缺口
words.mnemonic: de(负)+fic(做)+it → 做出亏空 → 赤字

words.definition: v. 滑行；滑翔 n. 滑行；滑翔

examples.en: The swan glided gracefully across the calm lake.
examples.zh: 天鹅优雅地滑过平静的湖面。

examples.en: The pilot glided the plane to a safe landing after the engine failed.
examples.zh: 发动机失灵后，飞行员驾机滑翔安全着陆。

words.usage: 不及物动词，强调平稳无声地移动，常与 across、down、into 连用。名词 glide 指滑行或滑翔动作；glider 指滑翔机。辨析：slide 贴面滑动，glide 更轻盈连贯。

confusables.note: glade 林间空地；差一字母

collocations: glide smoothly 平稳滑行
glide to a halt 滑行至停
glide across the ice 掠过冰面
words.mnemonic: 与 slide(滑动)近形，g 更轻盈 → 滑行

words.definition: n. 药丸；药片；避孕药

examples.en: Losing the contract was a bitter pill for the firm to swallow.
examples.zh: 丢掉合同对公司来说是难以吞咽的苦果。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed some pills to relieve the pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了些药丸来缓解疼痛。

words.usage: 可数名词；习语 a bitter pill to swallow 指难以接受的事实。服药用 take pills，不说 eat pills；the pill 特指口服避孕药。派生：pillbox n. 药盒。
collocations: take a pill 服药
sleeping pill 安眠药
a bitter pill 难咽的苦果
words.mnemonic: bill(账单)买 pill(药丸) → 一字母之差

words.definition: n. 汽油

examples.en: Petrol prices have risen sharply over the past few months.
examples.zh: 过去几个月汽油价格急剧上涨。

examples.en: We stopped at the station to fill the tank with petrol.
examples.zh: 我们在加油站停车加满了油。

words.usage: 英式英语用词，美式说 gasoline 或 gas，考研阅读英美语境均可能出现。不可数名词，常作定语：petrol prices、petrol station。派生：petrol bomb n. 燃烧弹。
collocations: petrol station 加油站
petrol prices 汽油价格
run out of petrol 汽油耗尽
words.mnemonic: petroleum(石油)炼制品 → 汽油（英式）

words.definition: adj. 光荣的；辉煌的；晴朗的

examples.en: The team celebrated its glorious victory in the final.
examples.zh: 球队庆祝决赛中辉煌的胜利。

examples.en: We spent a glorious afternoon walking along the coast.
examples.zh: 我们沿着海岸度过了一个晴好的下午。

words.usage: 既形容胜利、历史等「光荣、辉煌」，也形容天气「晴朗绝佳」，阅读中后者常见。派生：glory n. 荣誉，荣耀；gloriously adv. 辉煌地。比较级 more glorious。
collocations: glorious victory 辉煌胜利
glorious weather 晴好天气
a glorious chapter 光辉篇章
words.mnemonic: glory(荣誉)+ous → 荣耀满身 → 光荣的

words.definition: adj. 琐碎的；小气的；次要的

examples.en: He was dismissed for petty theft at the workplace.
examples.zh: 他因在工作场所小偷小摸被解雇。

examples.en: Don't waste energy on such petty quarrels.
examples.zh: 别把精力浪费在这种琐碎的争吵上。

words.usage: 多作定语：petty crime（轻微犯罪）、petty quarrel（琐碎争吵）。形容人心胸狭窄也常用，如 petty jealousy（小心眼的嫉妒）。派生：pettiness n. 琐碎；小气。
collocations: petty crime 轻微罪行
petty quarrel 琐碎争吵
petty official 小官吏
words.mnemonic: pet(宠物)+ty → 小家子气 → 琐碎；小气

words.definition: n. 柱子；支柱；栋梁

examples.en: Education is one of the pillars of a modern society.
examples.zh: 教育是现代社会的支柱之一。

examples.en: The roof is supported by four ancient stone pillars.
examples.zh: 屋顶由四根古石柱支撑。

words.usage: 比喻义高频：a pillar of society 或 the community（社会/社区的中坚）。习语 from pillar to post 指四处奔波、走投无路。派生：pillar-box n. 邮筒。
collocations: a pillar of society 社会支柱
stone pillar 石柱
from pillar to post 四处奔波
words.mnemonic: 谐音「劈了」——整木劈了做柱 → 柱子

words.definition: n. 斜坡；坡度 v. 倾斜

examples.en: The path slopes gently down to the river.
examples.zh: 小路缓缓向下倾斜，直通河边。

examples.en: They climbed the steep slope to reach the temple.
examples.zh: 他们爬上陡坡抵达寺庙。

words.usage: 名词常与 steep、gentle 搭配表坡度陡缓；动词不及物，如 slope down、slope up（向下/向上倾斜）。数学中指斜率。派生：sloping adj. 倾斜的。
collocations: steep slope 陡坡
gentle slope 缓坡
ski slope 滑雪坡道
words.mnemonic: 谐音「斯楼坡」——楼前有坡 → 斜坡

words.definition: n. 图表；海图 v. 绘制；记录

examples.en: The report charts the rise of online shopping over a decade.
examples.zh: 该报告记录了十年来网购的兴起。

examples.en: The captain marked the ship's course on the chart.
examples.zh: 船长在海图上标出船的航线。

words.usage: 作动词后接变化过程：chart the rise 或 fall of（记录…的起伏）。名词在商务语境指 bar chart、pie chart 等图表。top the charts 指登顶音乐排行榜。
collocations: bar chart 条形图
pie chart 饼状图
chart the course 规划路线
words.mnemonic: ch+art(艺术) → 数据画成艺术 → 图表

words.definition: n. 慈善；慈善机构；施舍

examples.en: She donates a third of her income to charity every year.
examples.zh: 她每年将收入的三分之一捐给慈善机构。

examples.en: The shelter is run by volunteers from local charities.
examples.zh: 这家收容所由当地慈善机构的志愿者运营。

words.usage: 可数指慈善机构，不可数指慈善行为。高频搭配 donate to charity（捐给慈善机构）。习语 charity begins at home 指仁爱先施于亲友。派生：charitable adj. 慈善的。
collocations: donate to charity 捐给慈善机构
charity event 慈善活动
charity organization 慈善组织
words.mnemonic: char(慈爱)+ity → 有爱的组织 → 慈善

words.definition: n. 热；高温；激烈 vt. 加热

examples.en: The summer heat made it hard to work outdoors.
examples.zh: 夏季高温使户外工作变得困难。

examples.en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 先把锅里的油加热，再放入蔬菜。

words.usage: 名词不可数；in the heat of the moment 指一时激动之下。动词短语 heat up 指升温，也指局势升级。派生：heated adj. 激烈的；heater n. 加热器。
collocations: heat up 加热；升温
in the heat of the moment 一时冲动
heat source 热源
words.mnemonic: h+eat(吃) → 吃前先加热 → 热

words.definition: n. 总理；大臣；（英）大学校长

examples.en: The German chancellor attended the summit on climate change.
examples.zh: 德国总理出席了气候变化峰会。

examples.en: The chancellor of the university conferred degrees on the graduates.
examples.zh: 大学校长为毕业生授予学位。

words.usage: 指德国、奥地利总理；英国财政大臣称 the Chancellor of the Exchequer；英联邦大学名誉校长亦用此词。美式大学校长用 president。派生：chancellorship n. 任期。
collocations: German chancellor 德国总理
Chancellor of the Exchequer 英国财政大臣
university chancellor 大学（名誉）校长
words.mnemonic: chance(机缘)+llor → 逢机缘掌权者 → 总理
